about: What players are saying about Forever (tools/kb/community.py): the week's top threads of the official forums' Forever discussion and r/wowforever (via web search). Per thread its title, link, day, counts and one line in our own words; no author, post text or comment. Opinions, never the source of a date or a game fact.
